errors.compatibilityNotFound: Vehicle compatibility {{pair}}: brand or model code not found (use Brand Code:Model Code).
errors.notProductTemplate: This file is not a Product import template. Download the template for Item Type {{expected}} and keep its "How To" sheet.
errors.productExists: A {{itemType}} product named {{name}} with this brand already exists.
errors.wrongItemType: This file is a template for Item Type {{found}}; it cannot be imported as {{expected}}. Download the {{expected}} template.

help.compatibilities: At least one Brand Code:Model Code pair; separate several with ";" (e.g. HINO:H500; ISUZU:ELF).
help.componentCategoryCode: Code of a Component Category of that group.
help.componentGroupCode: Component Group code or abbreviation (e.g. CG-TYRE or WTY).
help.dualLoadIndex: Load index code; required for Vehicle Group TRUCK_BUS.
help.gradeSpecification: Required when the product category requires a specification grade.
help.intervalValue: Whole number; required when {{condition}} is Yes.
help.intro: Each Item Type has its own template with its own specification columns. Choose the Item Type, download its template, fill "Fill Here" and upload it; the file is checked against that Item Type.
help.plyRating: Ply rating code; required for Vehicle Group TRUCK_BUS.
help.productCategoryCode: Code of a Product Category (or subcategory) that applies to this Item Type.
help.shelfLife: Whole number; required when Track Expiry is Yes.
help.storageBin: Default storage bin: Warehouse Code/Zone Code/Rack Code/Bin Code.
help.storageRequirements: Storage Requirement codes separated by ";"; required when Hazardous is Yes.
help.uomCode: Code of a Unit of Measure, e.g. PCS.

rules.codes: References are given by code (Product Category, UOM, Component Group or its abbreviation, Component Category / Subcategory, types and ratings). Storage Bin: Warehouse Code/Zone Code/Rack Code/Bin Code, e.g. WH-JKT/Z1/R1/B01.
rules.duplicate: A product with the same Item Name and Brand of this Item Type may exist only once (letter case ignored), in your company and in the file.
rules.generated: Item Code and SKU are generated on import; do not add them.
rules.itemType: This template is for Item Type {{itemType}} only; it is rejected for any other Item Type. Keep row 2 of this sheet unchanged.
rules.sameRules: Every row is checked with the same rules as New Product: Item Type and category, Component Group → Category → Subcategory, mandatory and conditional specification fields, UOM and references.
